name: How God Wants Us To Live
overview: God desires that we live with a heart aligned to His will, embracing justice, mercy, and humility as shown in Micah 6:8. Life according to God’s Word means trusting His guidance rather than following our own flawed understanding, for the way that seems right to man leads to death (Proverbs 14:12). We are called to seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness, assured that He will provide for our needs (Matthew 6:33), and to find sustenance not merely in physical bread but in every word that proceeds from God (Matthew 4:4). This life is marked by peace and hope, grounded in the knowledge that God’s plans for us are good and purposeful (Jeremiah 29:11), and free from envy or fretfulness over evil (Psalms 37:1).
